cues.en: In this video I'm going to tell you about factoring polynomials.
cues.zh: 這段介紹多項式因式分解。

cues.en: So let me first tell you what it means to factor a polynomial.
cues.zh: 先說明這是什麼意思，

cues.en: And before telling you how about factoring polynomials I'm going to tell you about factoring integers.
cues.zh: 在多項式前，先談整數分解。

cues.en: We can take the number four and represent four as the multiplication of two other numbers: 2 and 2.
cues.zh: 4 可以表示成另外兩個數字，2、2 相乘，

cues.en: So what we're doing is taking this larger number and expressing it as the product of simpler terms.
cues.zh: 也就是把較大的數字，表示為更簡單項目的乘積，

cues.en: That's the general idea of factoring.
cues.zh: 這是因式分解的整體概念。

cues.en: So here we can also take 16.
cues.zh: 再看 16，

cues.en: Now you can represent 16 as being two times eight.
cues.zh: 可以是 2 乘以 8，

cues.en: But the number eights of course can be factored or broken down into four times two.
cues.zh: 8 當然又能拆成 4 乘以 2，

cues.en: And of course four, as you learned here, and I'm sure you knew even before this course, four can be represented as two times two.
cues.zh: 4，如這裡所學，而且課前應該就知道，能表示成 2 乘以 2。

cues.en: So we can also factor the number 16 into two times two times two times two.
cues.zh: 所以 16 也能分解成 2 乘 2 乘 2 乘 2。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's just a general principle of factoring. Applied to polynomials, the concept is the same.
cues.zh: 這是分解的一般原則，多項式概念也相同，

cues.en: It's a little bit more challenging but the idea is that this polynomial can be represented as the product of two terms.
cues.zh: 稍微難一點，但這個多項式能表示成兩項的乘積，

cues.en: One of those terms is X plus 1.
cues.zh: 一項是 x+1，

cues.en: And the other term is x plus three and you can do the math fairly quickly in your head to confirm that these are equal.
cues.zh: 另一項 x+3，可以快速心算，確認相同。

cues.en: So X times X is X squared and then X times three is three x plus one times X gives us four X and then one times three gives us three.
cues.zh: x 乘 x 是 x 平方，x 乘 3 是 3x，再加 1 乘 x，得到 4x，1 乘 3 是 3。

cues.en: Now when you learn about factoring polynomials in a math course, then there are some tricks that you
cues.zh: 數學課教多項式因式分解，有一些技巧，

cues.en: can learn to help you figure out whether a polynomial is factorable and how to do this; things like completing the square and so on.
cues.zh: 能幫助判斷是否可分解，以及如何做，例如配方法。

cues.en: But in this video I'm going to show you how to get Python to do this for you.
cues.zh: 這裡示範讓 Python 代勞。

cues.en: So let's start by creating some symbolic variables x and y because later on in a few moments I'm going
cues.zh: 先建立符號變數 x、y，因為等一下，

cues.en: to create some multi variable polynomials.
cues.zh: 會用多變數多項式，

cues.en: So we need X comma Y.
cues.zh: 所以需要 x、y。

cues.en: So let's just start by taking a simple polynomial p and let's set this to be X squared plus four times x plus three.
cues.zh: 從簡單的 p 開始，x 平方加 4x 加 3，

cues.en: So that's in fact the same polynomial that I just showed in the slides. So I can just print this out like this or I can use sym dot factor.
cues.zh: 和投影片相同。可以直接印出，也能用 sym.factor，

cues.en: So this function factor and that is going to express this polynomial this polynomial as one plus or so x plus 1 times x plus three.
cues.zh: factor 把多項式表示成，1 加，應該是括號 x+1，乘以括號 x+3。

cues.en: Now you've probably learned in your math course that not every polynomial can be factored like this.
cues.zh: 數學課可能學過，不是每個都能這樣分解，

cues.en: Only some polynomials can be factored.
cues.zh: 只有部分可以，

cues.en: They have to be, you know, they have to have the right coefficients and so forth.
cues.zh: 得有適當係數等等。

cues.en: So for example if we would say minus three instead of plus three.
cues.zh: 例如 +3 改成 -3，

cues.en: Now it turns out that this polynomial on its own is no longer factorable.
cues.zh: 就不能再這樣因式分解。

cues.en: And now what's going to happen when we put this polynomial as input into the factor function?
cues.zh: 把它傳進 factor，會發生什麼？

cues.en: And the answer is that we just get back exactly the same result.
cues.zh: 答案是，得到完全相同的東西。

cues.en: And this is a feature of sympy that I've introduced you to in previous videos.
cues.zh: 這是之前介紹過的 SymPy 特性，

cues.en: So if you want simply to do something like factor or expand or simplify but it's just not possible with
cues.zh: 如果想做 factor、expand、simplify，但，

cues.en: the input that you've given it, then the output will be exactly the same as the input.
cues.zh: 給的輸入做不到，就原樣輸出。

cues.en: So this polynomial is not factorable.
cues.zh: 這個多項式無法分解，

cues.en: It is as simple as it gets already written out like this.
cues.zh: 已經是最簡形式，

cues.en: And so the output of the Factor function is just the same as the input.
cues.zh: factor 輸出和輸入相同。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: The next thing that I want to show you is factoring a polynomial with multiple variables.
cues.zh: 接著是多變數因式分解。

cues.en: So let's say two times X cubed times Y minus two times X squared plus two times X squared times Y plus
cues.zh: 例如 2x 三次方乘 y，減 2x 平方，加 2x 平方乘 y，再加，

cues.en: six times X squared minus six times X times Y.
cues.zh: 6x 平方，減 6xy。

cues.en: Now it may actually seem like I'm just making this stuff up as I go along but actually I've already
cues.zh: 你可能覺得我邊寫邊亂想，其實，

cues.en: worked through this problem to make sure that this polynomial in fact is factorable in two variables.
cues.zh: 事先做過，確定這個雙變數多項式能分解。

cues.en: So let's see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 看看外觀，

cues.en: So sym dot factor and then we input expr like this.
cues.zh: sym.factor，傳入 expr，像這樣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now you can see that the simplified version looks, or the factored version is a little bit simpler.
cues.zh: 化簡後，或者說分解後，形式稍微簡單。

cues.en: And in fact what you can see here, which you can also see when looking at this original equation, is that there is a two X in every term.
cues.zh: 這裡看得到，原式也看得到，每項都有 2x，

cues.en: So there's a 2 x here and you pulled out and you get X squared there's a 2 x term here and you got 2 times X that's actually this term here.
cues.zh: 這裡提出 2x，留下 x 平方；這裡也有 2x，這一項留下 2 乘 x，對應這裡。

cues.en: And then you might think that this is a mistake because there's a minus sign here and there's no minus sign here.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得錯了，因為這裡有負號，那裡沒有，

cues.en: However, we have this other term here six X squared.
cues.zh: 但還有另一項 6x 平方，

cues.en: And so the two X comes out of this leaving us with three X..
cues.zh: 提出 2x，留下 3x，

cues.en: And then that gets subtracted from one X leaving us with plus two X.
cues.zh: 再減去一個 x，剩正 2x。

cues.en: Of course I encourage you to get out a piece of paper and a pencil and confirm that this expression really equals this expression.
cues.zh: 當然，請拿紙筆，確認這兩個式子相等。

cues.en: But the main point is that factoring in sympy is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 重點是，SymPy 的分解很直接，

cues.en: You use the factor function.
cues.zh: 使用 factor。

cues.en: So here is the exercise for this video.
cues.zh: 練習如下，

cues.zh: 可以就像這樣顯示因式，不可以就印出「無法分解」。

cues.zh: 這不是打錯，

cues.zh: 不是漏了右括號，

cues.zh: 代表 i 至少出現一次，第一次出現的位置是索引 1。

cues.en: And remember that Python starts indexing at zero starts counting at zero.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 索引從 0 開始，

cues.en: So index of 1 actually means the second element.
cues.zh: 所以索引 1 實際是第二個字元。
